runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records keep their own verifiedAt unless their public detail was actually reopened or otherwise reconfirmed.
runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 16:36 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Kariera/Zoznam, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit was confirmed. Upwork produced several fresh Worldwide VA/WordPress candidates but they failed on client trust, scope economics, hard-development requirements, English burden or weak effective pay. Kariera produced fresh Bratislava administration/support results, but the closest candidates failed on low pay, language or qualification burden. Facebook public indexing produced 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: New-client trust confidence layer
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Penalize freelance listings from brand-new or near-empty client accounts until payment history, verified spend or concrete hiring history is visible. This reduces false-positive ranking of superficially attractive high fixed-price VA jobs with weak trust evidence.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Search reproducibility snapshot
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Persist the exact query family, search timestamp and result-count fingerprint for each source family so future runs can distinguish a genuinely unchanged market from a failed or partial index response without touching UI/renderers.
